title: Advance Impex Pvt. Ltd. v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Tarun Agarwala, J.; Vipin Sinha, J. (final); Ashok Bhushan, J.; Ram Autar Singh, J. (interim, 09.09.2009)
disposition: Writ dismissed as infructuous by lapse of time.
headnote: Challenge to an additional-security demand under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was not decided on merits. After a 2009 interim restraining the demand while the writ was listed with similar matters, the petition was dismissed as infructuous by lapse of time on the petitioner's statement.
facts: The petitioner company challenged PVVNL's 5 February 2009 demand notice seeking additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. On 9 September 2009 the Court listed the writ with similar 2009 matters, including Vehlna Steels (WP 30582/2009), and, following that sister interim, restrained the respondents from demanding additional security until further orders, without prejudice. In August 2016 counsel stated the petition had become infructuous by lapse of time.

holding_units.holding: The legality of the additional-security demand under para 4.20 was not decided. After listing with similar 2009 writs and an interim restraint on the demand following a sister order, the writ was dismissed as infructuous by lapse of time on counsel's statement.

not_decided.point: Whether additional security could be demanded under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: The 5 February 2009 demand was not examined on merits; the writ was dismissed as infructuous.
